protocol.purpose: Engineering speed and numerical equivalence only; no model fitting or official test access
protocol.records: Same 16 fit ECGs selected without labels for the completed parallel pilot
protocol.precision: float64 / complex128; no fast math; CUDA FMA disabled
protocol.algorithm: Frozen VMD settings and restart-from-initialization retry limits; CPU FFT and descriptors, GPU iterative updates
protocol.gpu_kernel: One 256-thread block per lead; at most 64 iterations per kernel launch
variants: CPU serial reference on first two pilot records, four leads per batch
GPU four-lead batches on first two records
CPU eight-worker baseline on all 16 records, four leads per batch
GPU all 192 leads batched together on all 16 records
protocol.timing: Synchronized wall time includes VMD retries, transfers, reconstruction and CPU descriptors; source loading, reference checks and artifact writes excluded; CPU pool startup included and reported
protocol.startup: Record GPU context initialization and synthetic compilation/warmup separately

checks.iterations: Require exact per-lead final iteration counts and retry limits; log every attempt
checks.feature_names: Require exact names and record/lead ordering
checks.mismatch_policy: Retain mismatch diagnostics, report failure, do not promote GPU output into the production run

protocol.full_extraction: Keep existing CPU extraction stopped during timings; no automatic backend switch or full GPU launch
protocol.output: Separate directory with status, manifest, timings, per-record diagnostics, predictions_available=false and retained failure traces

input.unit: one full 10-second 12-lead ECG per feature row

split.official_test: reserved; no feature extraction or predictions in this runner

vmd.features: 28 mode descriptors per mode per lead; concatenate leads
vmd.unconverged: stop and log; do not exclude or silently accept

wst.pooling: mean of log coefficients over time for orders 1/2; signed linear order 0

preprocessing.scaler: training StandardScaler then tanh times pi/2

controls.dummy: always-negative predictions and constant fit-partition prevalence scores

evaluation.uncertainty: paired patient-cluster bootstrap of validation ECG predictions; average differences across all three VQC seeds
evaluation.interpretation: internal validation only; no quantum advantage or clinical deployment claim

engineering_check.selection: smallest SHA-256 of protocol id plus record id among fit records; labels unused
engineering_check.kymatio_reference: all leads of each engineering-check record at the same settings
